title: Fix invalid `version_get_shader()` crash
body:
This fixes a bug in `shader_rd`. When a shader variant failes to compiles all the variants of the version get cleared but it isn't not marked as invalid. This results in an out-of-bounds read later on.

A new structure is added to keep track of the group compilations results. Then only when all variants have compiled successfully does the version become valid.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?
- Fixes the crash of #123422

## Additional information
Can be tested by creating a mesh and material and enabling subsurface scattering and transmittance on the material.
mrp: [mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32696300/mrp.zip)

It should be noted that the engine will still freezes when testing for the crash. This is due to EditorLog and EditorToaster not being able to handle the 45k lines of logs that get generated by the compile failiure.
